facts.fact: Amrita 让病人 Sylvie 再做一组抬腿；Sylvie 抱怨「上次也这么说」，仍继续做。
facts.anchor: Amrita encouraged her patient with a smile

facts.fact: Sylvie 做完五次后停下，狠狠瞪墙角的助行器，说要重新站起来。
facts.anchor: She gave the walker in the corner a glare so venomous

facts.fact: 两人成交：Sylvie 做她戏称「青蛙跳」的 plié squats，Amrita 以 samosas 作为交换。
facts.anchor: Samosas for demented forgotten-how-to-leave-the-floor frog jumps?

facts.fact: 几天后 Jamie 在 Sylvie 家厨房摊开设计图——他本是受老友 Mia 之托来给建议。
facts.anchor: Jamie looked at the designs spread across Sylvie’s kitchen table

facts.fact: Sylvie 不问报价当场把建屋工程交给 Jamie。
facts.anchor: You want the job, I want you to do it. So, you’re hired.

facts.fact: Amrita 送腕托到场，两人握手时 Jamie 的魔法剧烈翻涌，他说话打结。
facts.anchor: the world dimmed around him and his magic flared deep inside

facts.fact: Amrita 翻图后当面指出设计未做长期适老化考虑，随后提前离场。
facts.anchor: I don’t think they’re very well future-proofed

facts.fact: 一周后 Jamie 让 Mist 推着他要来号码，致电 Amrita 道歉，约定一晚过设计（她拒绝他请吃饭）。
facts.anchor: I reacted badly to what could have been good professional advice
